summary: Scope correction of postulated GR recovery and constrained Hamiltonian calculation for the existing homogeneous Palatini-Holst comparator.

stage_events.description: The supplied task requires work in PR #807, retention of allowed Holst/torsion terms, explicit assumptions, formal and computational checks, and preservation of author attestations.
Supplied an external review and requested verification before continuing PR #807.
The agent reused the prior Clifford, split-jet and homogeneous curvature results; distinguished independent-connection vacuum variation from the one-clock composite reduction.

Computed the homogeneous primary Poisson matrix, second-class reduction, clock Hamiltonian and distinct zero-coefficient constraint branch; implemented general bivector and Legendre identities in Lean. This records this turn execution, not sole origin of the mathematical model.

Cross-checked the encoded formulas with independent symbolic differentiation, general tetrad four-form variations, numerical finite differences, Lorentz covariance, integrator convergence and arbitrary precision. Formal checking and CI have separately recorded status.

Verified the self-dual canonical match, corrected the transformed clock momentum, derived the formal dust-like integration constant, and found that naive complex rotation fails the original Hermitian-pair tetrad readout, including a linearized homogeneous counterexample.
